'''Coine din Jubai Wild Winds''' is an [[Atha'an Miere]] [[Sailmistress]] of the ''[[Wavedancer]]''. 

== Appearance ==
She has black hair with touches of gray in it, and brown eyes with fine wrinkles on the corners of them.

== Activities ==
She takes [[Elayne Trakand]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] from [[Tear]] to [[Tanchico]] when they are tracking down the [[Black Ajah]]. She mentions for the first times to the girls about the [[Jendai Prophecies]] and the return of the [[Coramoor]] when she sees that the [[Stone of Tear]] has fallen.{{ref/book|4|19}}

On the voyage to Tanchico she intercepts other Sea Folk ships to tell them of the coming of the Coramoor.{{ref/book|4|35}}

After dropping Elayne and Nynaeve off in Tanchico she plans to visit various Sea Folk islands to inform as many as possible that the Coramoor has appeared.{{ref/book|4|39}}
